jobs.title: Founding Backend Engineer (Python / Go)
jobs.description: We are building next-generation payment infrastructure for African merchants. Looking for a founding engineer to design high-throughput APIs and transaction ledgers.
mustHaves: PostgreSQL database design and query optimization
Shipped an API used by external customers

jobs.title: Full-Stack Product Engineer (React / Node)
jobs.description: Connecting patients to verified clinics and pharmacy deliveries across West Africa. You will own patient-facing dashboards and clinician workflows.
mustHaves: 3+ years building web applications with React or TypeScript
niceToHaves: Tailwind CSS and responsive mobile-first UI design

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer (Flutter / React Native)
jobs.description: Building driver, warehouse dispatch, and tracking applications optimized for low-bandwidth cellular environments.
mustHaves: 2+ years in mobile development with Flutter or React Native
Offline-first synchronization and SQLite or Realm caching
Shipped at least one app to Google Play Store or App Store

jobs.title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Lead
jobs.description: Lead automated cloud provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes cluster health, and multi-region disaster recovery.
mustHaves: 3+ years managing production cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP)
